details: Package ships an index.js that requires child_process and spawns 'cmd' at line 91. Without traced evidence of what command is executed, what data is collected, or where any output is sent, the behavior cannot be classified as installer-harm. The pattern is consistent with legitimate cross-platform CLI dispatch as well as with reconnaissance/exfiltration; the shape alone is not evidence of either. No hardcoded attacker endpoint, credential path read, lifecycle hook auto-execution, or fetched-and-executed payload has been identified in the available evidence.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
